result.decision_rationale: All three round-eight fixes are verified. The final commit passed the required qualification gate. The packaging suite passed on its parent, and the final commit changes only two evidence files. The evidence supports the UMM 0.31.1 compile baseline and the documented managed compatibility results. Native gameplay remains unqualified. One stale source comment is optional polish.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: LoaderReferences.targets now emits the generated-source marker only when framework-attribute generation is enabled, attribute text is present, and there are compile items. With generation disabled, the CallerFilePath fixture recorded the external source's path digest. Packaging accepted the first build, refused its receipt after relocation to a byte-identical copy, and accepted the rebuilt DLL with its new digest.

Default standalone validation no longer acquires the publication lock. With .publish.lock held exclusively, the distinct valid ZIP passed and the published ZIP and both receipts retained their hashes. The suite also confirmed refusal of the explicit canonical receipt path and failure when an explicitly requested separate report could not be written.
The historical paragraph attributes 145/145 to round six at 27c0af5 and directs readers to the evidence index for the current run. The index and loader-baseline.json agree on 166/166 at d95aea7.
